brief.text: GameStop Corp. (GME) recorded the largest total cluster value at $48.4 million across four insiders, while Bank Bradesco (BBD) showed an unusually high insider count with 21 buyers totaling $28.95 million. Closed-end funds appeared repeatedly across the cluster table with RWAY ($169,183) and GAM ($284,880), with RWAY also featuring in notable individual transactions via director Edward Goldthorpe's $67,450 trade. Among individual filings, TPVG CEO James Labe posted the largest officer transaction at $1.48 million, alongside a $4.58 million purchase in CRBG by 10% owner Nippon Life Insurance Co.
